facts.rowsWrittenDefinition: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE rows contribute to rows written; indexed writes can add additional written rows.
facts.observability: Per-query meta exposes rows_read/rows_written; dashboard and GraphQL Analytics can also track usage.

officialSources.title: Cloudflare D1 free-tier limit enforcement changelog

facts.enforcement: Queries fail once the account exceeds daily row-read or row-write limits until midnight UTC reset.

governanceImplications: The hard writer ceiling is account-wide rather than a per-workflow or per-database budget.
system2-isolated-d1-writer concurrency prevents simultaneous mutation but cannot prevent sequential workflows from consuming the same 100,000-row account-wide daily write allowance.
Known per-run rowsWritten can be accumulated as an auditable lower bound; unknown external/account writers require conservative reserve rather than claiming an exact remaining quota.
Writer reservation must account for index-amplified rows where applicable.

Rows-read risk is secondary but real: the same account has a 5,000,000 rows-read/day Free ceiling and should be observed by the same governance surface even though CORR-003 was opened from a write-limit failure.
No paid-plan upgrade is authorized by this evidence.
remediationAcceptanceRefinement: Global Free-plan budget constant must use official ceiling 100,000 rowsWritten per UTC day at the account level unless future vendor evidence changes.
UTC quota day resets at 00:00 UTC.
Use query meta/dashboard/GraphQL evidence when available; otherwise conservative known-write accounting plus reservation estimates must fail/defer rather than invent available headroom.
A workflow classified as bulk/high-write must not start if its conservative reservation would exceed the remaining auditable writer budget after protected reservations.
Quota deferral must be classified operationally (QUOTA_BUDGET_DEFERRED or equivalent), not as source/data failure.
